The calculator prints under valuation.missing: “WACC is not computed: the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched”, and under cost_of_capital.missing: “the cost of equity needs a beta and a price: no price series was given: the forward track's price source is Tiingo, and without its token no series is fetched”. So there is no value range per share, and no enterprise value, equity value or value per share for any scenario. The inputs that are on record are the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, the equity risk premium of {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct}, the tax rate of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, total debt of {ratios.solvency.total_debt}, net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt} and a share count of {terms.shares_outstanding}. The two missing inputs are the beta and the market value of equity. With no debt on record the cost of debt carries no weight, so an override of it, which the first pass did not make, could not have filled the gap. Nothing is put in place of the value Python could not compute; the drivers in assumptions.json are read against the company's own record in the sections below.

What the price assumes about growth therefore cannot be stated. What can be read is the record the implied rate would have been set against, and where the drivers sit in it. Revenue grew at a three-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} and a five-year rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}. Fiscal 2025 grew {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.revenue_growth|pct}, the trailing four quarters {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, and the latest quarter {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} on the year. The release, quoted, raised the full-year growth guide, and the trailing rate sits inside the raised range. The base case starts year one below that range and below the trailing rate but above both compound rates, and fades to a terminal rate below the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}. The bull case starts at the top of the guided range, and the bear case starts inside the low-growth years of fiscal 2022 to fiscal 2024. Without the price, there is no way to say whether it asks for more growth than the base case or less.

accounting_adjustments.reading: None. The accounting reader's adjustment list is empty, and its finding on earnings and cash ends “No adjustment: working capital as a whole absorbed cash rather than flattering it.” The calculator's quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} lists no adjustment applied. Its only deductions are the standing ones from simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}: share-based compensation ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}) and acquisitions ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}). The accounting reader did note small lifts to earnings: a lower quarterly tax rate tied to unrecognized tax benefits, a thinner bad-debt allowance and a restructuring reserve reversal. It left them unadjusted because their amounts are not in the calculator. Since the valuation was not computed, there is no figure for how much adjustments moved value, and with none applied there was nothing for them to move.

summary_ko.value_range: 주가 자료와 베타가 없어 가중평균자본비용(WACC)이 계산되지 않았고, 따라서 주당 가치 범위와 시나리오별 기업가치·주주가치도 계산되지 않았습니다. 기록에 남아 있는 입력값은 무위험이자율 {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, 주식위험프리미엄 {cost_of_capital.equity_risk_premium|pct}, 총차입금 {ratios.solvency.total_debt} 등이며, 빠진 값을 추정해 채우지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.price_position: 기준일 주가가 주어지지 않아 주가가 가치 범위의 어디쯤에 있는지 읽을 수 없습니다. 같은 주가가 필요한 잉여현금흐름 수익률 점검도 같은 이유로 계산되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.market_implied_growth: 역DCF가 계산되지 않아 현재 주가가 어떤 매출 성장률을 가정하는지는 알 수 없습니다. 비교 기준인 회사 기록은 삼 년 연평균 성장률 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}, 최근 네 분기 성장률 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}이며, 회사는 올해 매출 성장 전망을 높였고 기본 시나리오의 첫해 성장률은 그 전망보다 낮게 잡았습니다.
summary_ko.most_sensitive: 민감도 표가 계산되지 않아 어떤 가정이 가치를 가장 크게 움직이는지는 읽을 수 없습니다. 세 시나리오가 회사 기록을 서로 다르게 읽는 두 가정은 십 년 차 영업이익률(과거 최고 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct})과 첫해 매출 성장률(최근 네 분기 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct})입니다.
summary_ko.accounting_adjustments: 회계 분석에서 조정 항목이 하나도 없었고, 품질조정 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}에도 주식보상과 인수 지출 외의 추가 조정은 적용되지 않았습니다. 가치평가 자체가 계산되지 않아 조정이 가치를 얼마나 바꿨는지에 대한 수치도 없습니다.

limits: This valuation is a set of stated assumptions run through a stated formula. It states no recommendation to trade, and a different reader choosing different drivers would reach a different value.
